svg.title: AutoTrust ScienceGuru with Guru Turbo 1.2: NanoGPT Speedrun results
svg.desc: 91 official community records on a logarithmic time axis, plus 2 re-timings. Official SOTA: approximately 67.56 seconds. Other reported results: ANVIL2 39.914 seconds and Exact-match 47.2056 seconds. AutoTrust's ScienceGuru platform with Guru Turbo 1.2: 24.8998 seconds, five-seed mean on 2026-09-22. Details and source dates are documented in docs/SPEEDRUN_CHART.md.

Sources: KellerJordan/modded-nanogpt record history, PRs #360 / #367, and this repository’s five-seed logs. *Versus official SOTA ≈67.56 s.
Official times are rounded leaderboard minutes × 60; dates follow the source record / PR submission. Includes two #21 re-timings; timing rules changed after #21.
